reasoning_content: PostgreSQL 14 is installed but the cluster is stopped. Start the cluster and create the `samarbeid` user (matching the APP_DB_USERNAME default in database.yml.sample), then wait for it to finish.

action.command: pg_ctlcluster 14 main start 2>&1; pg_lsclusters; su postgres -c "psql -c \"CREATE ROLE samarbeid WITH LOGIN SUPERUSER PASSWORD 'samarbeid';\"" 2>&1; su postgres -c "psql -c 'SELECT version();'" 2>&1 | head -3
